history.summary: Large 1647sqft 3BR at $1214 psf is roughly 21% below the River Isles URA median of $1536, anchoring a sub-$2M entry into a 610-unit Punggol development with a strong 7.66%/yr resale CAGR on 154 transactions. Walkable to Riviera MRT (480m) with Punggol Digital District and CRL as durable D19 catalysts. The deep PSF discount on an oversized layout is the standout: real upside if the unit is a normal (not penthouse-only) configuration.
history.rating_rationale: Best combination of value and momentum in the batch: $1214 psf vs $1536 median, 7.66%/yr URA appreciation backed by 154 resale-only transactions (high confidence), and a 610-unit development gives a deep buyer pool. Sub-$2M price sits in a liquid band for HDB upgraders. Qingjian build with 3.3/5 reviews (units close together, average interior finishing) caps it below Strong Buy, and the unusually low PSF on 1647sqft warrants verifying the layout isn't a hard-to-resell penthouse. Catalysts (PDD, CRL ~2030) are concrete.
red_flags: Very low psf on a 1647sqft unit may indicate a penthouse/atypical layout that resells slowly
Average interior finishing and units sited close together (3.3/5 reviews)
Punggol 3BR resale competes against a deep supply of newer leasehold stock
catalysts: Punggol Digital District build-out and SIT campus driving tenant/buyer demand
Cross Island Line (~2030) improving D19 connectivity
Sub-$2M, ~21% below-median PSF entry leaves room for re-rating toward median

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 3BR in Punggol rents to families and PDD-linked tenants; demand is steady but not premium. Large floor area helps justify rent but caps yield given the $2M outlay.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 7.66%/yr resale CAGR on 154 transactions is robust and well above the OCR ~3.7% baseline, reflecting Punggol's transformation. Buying ~21% below the development median gives mean-reversion headroom.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale-only CAGR (154 txns) discounted modestly for forward supply
